pixel_directions: u increases rightward, v increases downward; horizontal coordinate wraps at seam
matrices: JSON rows, column-vector convention: X_world = R_c2w @ X_camera + t_c2w
rotation_columns: camera +X, +Y, +Z axes expressed in the chosen world frame
translation: camera centre in chosen world coordinates
world_to_camera: Exact numerical inverse of the supplied camera_to_world matrix
native_world: Original merged PanoVGGT world, same as PLY in companion ZIP; arbitrary monocular scale, not necessarily level
glb_world: Same as companion ZIP GLB: Y-up alignment, horizontal PCA, floor proxy, estimated scale from assumed 2.7m room height
glb_pose_formula: If X_glb=s*Q*X_native+b: R_glb=Q*R_native, t_glb=s*Q*t_native+b. Camera-local lengths must also scale by s.
opengl_camera_conversion: camera_to_world_glb_opengl = camera_to_world_glb @ diag(1,-1,-1,1); +X right,+Y up,-Z forward
depth_type: radial distance from camera centre, not pinhole optical-axis Z depth
inverse_mapping_note: The inverse formula above is derived from the forward pixel-centre convention; do not substitute width-1/height-1 endpoint normalization.
